description: React hook for managing pricing plans, subscriptions, and in-app purchases in the Notesnook mobile app.

methods.name: numberWithCommas
methods.description: Formats a number string with commas for thousands separator.

methods.name: toUUID
methods.description: Converts a string to a UUID format with specific prefix, version, and variant.

methods.name: getLocalizedPrice
methods.description: Returns localized price string for a product based on platform and product type.

methods.name: getOfferTokenAndroid
methods.description: Retrieves the offer token for an Android subscription product.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles the subscription process for a product, including platform-specific purchase requests.

methods.name: getPromoCycleText
methods.description: Returns promotional cycle description based on product and selected SKU.

methods.name: getBillingPeriod
methods.description: Returns billing period (week, month, year) for a product or plan.

methods.name: getBillingDuration
methods.description: Returns billing duration and type for a product or plan.

methods.name: getTrialInfo
methods.description: Provides trial period information for a subscription product.

methods.name: convertPrice
methods.description: Converts a price amount into formatted string with currency symbol.

methods.name: getDiscountValue
methods.description: Calculates discount percentage between two prices.

methods.name: compareProductPrice
methods.description: Compares prices of two SKUs within a plan to determine discount percentage.

methods.name: getPriceParts
methods.description: Splits a price into value and symbol parts for formatting.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns formatted price string for a product or plan phase.

methods.name: getRegionalDiscount
methods.description: Fetches regional discount info for a plan and product ID.

methods.name: isSubscribedToPlan
methods.description: Checks if user is subscribed to a specific plan.

methods.name: isSubscribedToProduct
methods.description: Checks if user is subscribed to a specific product ID.
